SELECT 
  step1.ID,
  step1.patient_avg_ana,
  ROUND(step1.patient_avg_ana - step2.overall_avg_ana, 2) as difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(ANA) as patient_avg_ana
  FROM Examination
  WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
) step1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as overall_avg_ana
  FROM (
    SELECT AVG(ANA) as patient_avg
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
  )
) step2
WHERE step1.patient_avg_ana > step2.overall_avg_ana
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
